source.note: The header typ is JWT and alg is RS256, the same as an access token. aud is the application's own ID. It has a nonce and no scp or roles.

notes: aud is bound to the product's audience on purpose. When a client and an API share one app registration the ID token's aud equals the API's audience, so aud alone cannot refuse it. This is the hardest case for a check that refuses ID tokens when the token type JWT is accepted.
